    How to play

    1. Cast. Tap the water. Aim for a fish shadow. A big shadow is a big fish.
    2. Hook. Small dips are nibbles. Tap when the float goes under.
    3. Reel. Hold to reel. Let go when the bar turns red or the fish runs.

    Keyboard: arrow keys aim. Space casts, hooks and reels.
